messages:
Clara (AE): FitLab POC is blocked. They hit 401 + "scope_mismatch" on /v1/generate from their CI nightly job.
Customer: error body: {"error":"scope_mismatch", "request_id":"rq_fl_900"} headers show x-rw-org: fitlab-labs. We rotated key yesterday but still failing.
Ralph (eng): most common: wrong scopes or key created in a different org/project. Ask them to call keys/inspect with the same Authorization header to confirm owner_org, owner_project, scopes.
Customer: ran inspect -> owner_org: fitlab-main, owner_project: poc-run, scopes: ["embeddings:read"].
Clara (AE): so the key is one that only has embeddings. That won't work for inference endpoints.
Ivy (support): quick remediation: create a new key scoped to inference:invoke (and chat:stream if needed) under the POC project. For CI, prefer a short-lived key and set a project spend cap.
Customer: we created a new key but CI still fails. Job logs show Authorization: Bearer sk-fl-new and header x-rw-org: fitlab-labs (old org).
Ralph (eng): aha — looks like CI sets RW_ORG env or the rw-client is configured with a persistent org header. If the header doesn't match the key's owner_org the gateway returns scope_mismatch.
Customer: where would that header be coming from?
Ivy (support): check CI env vars (RW_ORG, REDWOOD_ORG), config files, and any injected headers in your job template. Also check if a wrapper script adds x-rw-org for multi-tenant setups.
Customer: found RW_ORG in secrets set to fitlab-labs. Removed it and retried -> still 401, request_id rq_fl_901, header x-rw-auth: pending-propagation.
CI-Bot: Note: key propagation can take ~20-60s. If you rotate keys and immediately run many parallel jobs, some will hit auth cache before the new binding is visible.
Ralph (eng): wait 60s and retry. If it still fails, include the request_id and x-rw-* headers and we'll trace on infra side.
Customer: waited 90s and retried -> 200 OK, model returned tokens. POC back online.
Sam (security): follow-up guidance for the questionnaire: for POCs recommend creating a scoped, short-lived key with only inference:invoke; set expiry and project spend cap; enable IP allowlist for CI runners if feasible; avoid wildcard scopes.
Clara (AE): I'll send FitLab a short handoff email with: 1) how to inspect keys, 2) checklist for CI (remove stale RW_ORG, rotate keys, wait ~1m after creation), 3) how to set spend caps.
Ivy (support): logging tip: when reporting auth failures include request_id and any x-rw-* headers. We can pull traces fast with that.
Customer: appreciate the help — will update CI and the security team. Closing this thread. :white_check_mark:
